Legal Entailment Benchmark
	


	
		
		Dataset Description
	

The Legal Entailment Benchmark is a curated evaluation dataset for testing Natural Language Inference (NLI) models on legal contract text. It contains 508 hand-labeled examples covering 14 legal linguistic patterns where general-purpose NLI models consistently fail.

	
		
		Key Features
	


508 examples across 14 legal pattern categories
4-class schema: entailed, partially_entailed, contradicted, neutral

reputation: A small, targeted benchmark widely cited for evaluating NLI robustness on legal contract language but not a mainstream large-scale benchmark.
